basic_details.job_title: SVSU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Joint Director, Assistant Deputy Director and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Shri Vishwakarma Skill University (SVSU), the Government of Haryana skill university at Dudhola, Palwal, has invited offline applications for 4 posts on contract: Joint Director (1), Assistant Deputy Director (2) and Assistant Skill Coordinator (1), under Advt. No. SVSU/2026/Estt./Cont./059. Signed applications go by post to The Assistant Registrar (Estt.) and must reach by 07.12.2026 till 05:00 PM, as the notice rejects late receipt, including postal delay.

qualification.details: Age limit for all posts: 18-42 years. Age relaxation is as per Govt. of Haryana rules; the notice prints no further detail. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Qualification and experience are determined as on the last date of receipt of applications. | Other conditions for all posts: the candidate must be a citizen of India and must have knowledge of Hindi/Sanskrit as one of the subjects at matric level. Qualifications must be from recognized Boards/Universities/Institutes. A degree through an open university or distance education mode needs recognition by the Distance Education Council, IGNOU, New Delhi. Experience counts only after the prescribed essential qualification is obtained. | Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks in Engineering, Management, Health-Care, Computer Science, Social Science. A minimum of 15 years of teaching/Industry experience or experience in research at the University/Policy papers. Contribution to educational innovation, design of new curricula and technology-mediated teaching learning process. An outstanding professional with exceptional accomplishment established in the relevant field, who has made significant contributions to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, to be substantiated. Experience in any of the sectors: automobile, agriculture, apparel & textiles, IT&ITES, healthcare, Banking & Finance, retail, hospitality, electrical & electronics, construction, transport and logistics. Knowledge of Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric. | Desirable for Joint Director: | Complete knowledge of vocational education, skill development ecosystem and its stakeholders. In-depth knowledge and understanding of National Standard & Qualification Framework. Overall sectorial & industry knowledge, ability to analyse and collate demands and prepare a sustainable plan/models of skill programs/courses/work-study model and skilling framework. Establish national and international sectorial partnerships; support in establishing digital courseware; develop entrepreneurship development program. IT skills are mandatory. Preference will be given to Ex-servicemen / retired employees. | Master's degree with at least 55% of the marks in any discipline. A minimum of 5 years of teaching/industry experience or experience in research at the University/National Level. Preference to candidates with experience in any of the sectors: automobile, agriculture, apparel & textile, IT & ITES, Fine-Art, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Banking & Finance, retail, hospitality, electrical & electronics, construction, transport and logistics, healthcare or any other allied fields. Knowledge of Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric. | Desirable for Assistant Deputy Director: in-depth knowledge and understanding of National Standard & Qualification Framework; overall sectorial & industry knowledge with the ability to prepare a sustainable plan/models of skill programs/courses/work-study model and skilling framework; IT skills are mandatory. | Bachelor Degree with at least 50% of marks from a recognized university. Two years of experience. content_sections.heading: About SVSU
content_sections.text: The notice describes Shri Vishwakarma Skill University as the first Government Skill University established by the Government of Haryana. Its permanent campus is at Dudhola, District Palwal. The posts are on contract for three years.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be on the application form printed with the notice ("Application for Recruitment on Contract Basis"). The applicant must sign the form on each page and send it with all self-attested supporting documents in a sealed envelope. Write on the envelope: "Application for the post of (Name of the post) against Advt. No. SVSU/2026/Estt./Cont./059". Address: The Assistant Registrar (Estt.), Takshashila Bhawan (Admin Block), Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana-121102. The notice does not name the postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand). The fee is non-refundable and is paid in online mode at https://forms.eduqfix.com/svsurectff/add . The payment receipt must be enclosed with the application form. Section 9 of the form asks for the Application ID, payment date, receipt number, transaction ID, amount and the candidate's name.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Age limit for all posts: 18-42 years. Age relaxation is as per Govt. of Haryana rules; the notice prints no further detail. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Qualification and experience are determined as on the last date of receipt of applications. Other conditions for all posts: the candidate must be a citizen of India and must have knowledge of Hindi/Sanskrit as one of the subjects at matric level. Qualifications must be from recognized Boards/Universities/Institutes. A degree through an open university or distance education mode needs recognition by the Distance Education Council, IGNOU, New Delhi. Experience counts only after the prescribed essential qualification is obtained. Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks in Engineering, Management, Health-Care, Computer Science, Social Science. A minimum of 15 years of teaching/Industry experience or experience in research at the University/Policy papers. Contribution to educational innovation, design of new curricula and technology-mediated teaching learning process. An outstanding professional with exceptional accomplishment established in the relevant field, who has made significant contributions to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, to be substantiated. Experience in any of the sectors: automobile, agriculture, apparel & textiles, IT&ITES, healthcare, Banking & Finance, retail, hospitality, electrical & electronics, construction, transport and logistics. Knowledge of Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric. Desirable for Joint Director: Complete knowledge of vocational education, skill development ecosystem and its stakeholders. In-depth knowledge and understanding of National Standard & Qualification Framework. Overall sectorial & industry knowledge, ability to analyse and collate demands and prepare a sustainable plan/models of skill programs/courses/work-study model and skilling framework. Establish national and international sectorial partnerships; support in establishing digital courseware; develop entrepreneurship development program. IT skills are mandatory. Preference will be given to Ex-servicemen / retired employees. Master's degree with at least 55% of the marks in any discipline. A minimum of 5 years of teaching/industry experience or experience in research at the University/National Level. Preference to candidates with experience in any of the sectors: automobile, agriculture, apparel & textile, IT & ITES, Fine-Art, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Banking & Finance, retail, hospitality, electrical & electronics, construction, transport and logistics, healthcare or any other allied fields. Knowledge of Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric. Desirable for Assistant Deputy Director: in-depth knowledge and understanding of National Standard & Qualification Framework; overall sectorial & industry knowledge with the ability to prepare a sustainable plan/models of skill programs/courses/work-study model and skilling framework; IT skills are mandatory. Bachelor Degree

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form, signed on each page, with a recent passport-size photograph affixed and duly signed. Self-attested copies of all supporting documents and certificates. Application fee payment receipt. PH (PwBD) candidates: disability certificate from a Competent Authority, clearly stating the type of disability as defined in the Govt. letter dated 25.04.2018. Where a Grade Point System is used: the document converting CGPA into equivalent marks. Experience certificate showing period of work, designation with pay scale/pay band with grade pay/pay level, supported by salary slip/PF statement/Form 16/Bank Statement or other valid proof of salary. Document showing knowledge of Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric, as the form asks. Latest detailed C.V.; an additional sheet may be enclosed for other experience details. The form also asks for educational details from Matriculation/SSC onwards, employment details, the minimum joining time if selected, knowledge of fields such as computer, automobile, agriculture, IT & ITES, apparel & textiles, healthcare, banking & finance and retail, two references from the last five years, and any international, national or state-level awards.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes the selection only in brief. The University may conduct a skill test for shortlisting the candidates if required. Having the essential qualification and experience, which are described as the bare minimum, does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Merely appearing in an interview confirms no right of appointment or selection. No TA/DA is payable for attending any test or interview.

Detailed terms and conditions and updates

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are advertised in SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Four posts: 1 Joint Director, 2 Assistant Deputy Director and 1 Assistant Skill Coordinator. The notice says the vacancies are indicative and may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 07.12.2026 till 05:00 PM. The notice states that no application is entertained after the last date, whether due to postal delay or any other reason.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the posts?
faq.answer: Joint Director needs a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks in the listed fields and 15 years of experience. Assistant Deputy Director needs a Master's degree with at least 55% marks in any discipline and 5 years of experience. Assistant Skill Coordinator needs a Bachelor Degree with at least 50% marks and two years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18-42 years, with relaxation as per Govt. of Haryana rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Consolidated salary is Rs. 1,06,650/- for Joint Director, Rs. 48,600/- per month for Assistant Deputy Director and Rs. 32,625/- per month for Assistant Skill Coordinator. No other benefits are admissible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General candidates pay Rs. 1000/-. Scheduled Castes, Backward Classes, Ex-Service Men, Women and EWS candidates pay Rs. 250/-. Physically Disabled candidates are exempted. The fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the printed application form, sign every page, and enclose self-attested documents and the fee receipt. Send it in a sealed envelope to The Assistant Registrar (Estt.), Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana-121102.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be a skill test or interview?
faq.answer: The University may conduct a skill test for shortlisting if required. Meeting the minimum qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on contract for three years. The first offer letter is for six months and can be extended on performance and work & conduct report. No claim of regularisation or extension is entertained.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA is payable for attending any test or interview.
